'''Ryan Hemre''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Phoenix tournament]] on 20 April 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Mains]], according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2144">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-23-viper-tracks-phoenix-az-4-20-01d2144/ viper-tracks-phoenix-az-4-20-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 23 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-23-viper-tracks-phoenix-az-4-20-01d2144/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
